name: First Rhythm
description: Build a readable opening before adding pressure to the rope pattern.
rules: Keep the opening to one active rope when possible.
Do not take Rope Speed during the first three level-ups.
Choose a direct movement or protection card when the current landing feels unsafe.
bonusObjective: Finish with at least one Jump Height upgrade.
recommendedDirection: Readable timing and a stable landing matter more than aggressive scaling.

name: Two-Rope Discipline
description: Learn to create value without turning the screen into an unreadable rope field.
rules: Never keep more than two active ropes.
Prioritize Reinforce Rope before adding speed.
Do not take Ignite Rope before 5,000 score.
bonusObjective: Reach the target without losing a reinforced rope.
recommendedDirection: Use height and protection to make two ropes productive.

name: Late Ignition
description: Prove the airtime engine works before turning fire into a scoring layer.
rules: Do not take Ignite Rope before 10,000 score.
Build Jump Height or Rocket Fuel before increasing Rope Speed.
If rope pressure becomes unstable, choose protection over another scoring card.
bonusObjective: Finish with an active fire rope and Rocket Fuel.

name: Single-Rope Scholar
description: Study jump timing without solving the run by adding more ropes.
rules: Do not take Add Jump Rope.
Increase only one timing variable at a time.
After every Jump Height or Rope Speed pick, use two conservative jumps to relearn the rhythm.
bonusObjective: Reach the target without taking Ignite Rope.
recommendedDirection: Height, Luck and careful speed changes keep the challenge focused.

name: Sky Bridge
description: Build a clean bridge from natural jump height into powered airtime.
rules: Do not take Rocket Fuel before at least one Jump Height pick.
Keep a recoverable landing until fuel has bridged two successful jumps.
Delay Ignite Rope until the target is reached.
bonusObjective: Earn an upgrade while Rocket Shoes are active.
recommendedDirection: Height creates the runway; fuel extends it.

name: Moonbound Control
description: Follow the documented control-first route without turning the attempt into a fire build.
rules: Do not take Ignite Rope.
Simplify the rope set before the main height push.
Reinforce the ropes you plan to keep before relying on Rocket Fuel.
bonusObjective: Complete the route with three or fewer active ropes.
recommendedDirection: Control, height, Luck and late fuel match the documented player route.

name: Controlled Chaos
description: Add pressure deliberately and prove the run can support every new rope.
rules: Do not keep more than three active ropes.
Take Reinforce Rope before adding Rope Speed to a multi-rope setup.
Do not use Ignite Rope until the target is halfway complete.
bonusObjective: Finish with at least one Rocket-related upgrade.
recommendedDirection: Alternate pressure with protection instead of stacking danger twice.

name: Clover Foundation
description: Test a progression-first opening without pretending Luck has a known formula.
rules: Take Increase Luck when it appears during the first five level-ups unless the run needs immediate protection.
Do not add fire during the opening.
Record whether Lucky feedback or upgrade cadence visibly changes.
bonusObjective: Save a note about the observable effect of Luck.
recommendedDirection: Treat Luck as an observation, not a promised percentage.

name: Quiet Landing
target: Reach 4,000 score with a controllable landing rhythm.
description: Use a low-pressure run to notice where Scarlet lands after each movement change.
rules: Do not take two timing-changing upgrades on consecutive level-ups.
Keep no more than two active ropes.
Pause aggressive scaling whenever the landing point becomes unclear.
bonusObjective: Complete the target without taking Rope Speed.
recommendedDirection: Change one variable, observe it, then continue.

name: Rocket Reserve
description: Use Rocket Fuel as a bridge rather than spending the whole gauge immediately.
rules: Build normal Jump Height before depending on fuel.
Keep fuel in reserve until a late landing or upgrade bridge needs it.
Do not add a fourth rope before the fuel loop repeats successfully.
bonusObjective: Bridge from one upgrade to another without landing.
recommendedDirection: Fuel is most useful when the rest of the run gives it a destination.

name: Four-Rope Finale
description: Turn a stable engine into a deliberately crowded late-run pattern.
rules: Build a stable height foundation before keeping four ropes.
Reinforce the active set before adding fire.
If Add Jump Rope is not offered, the score target remains the valid completion condition.
bonusObjective: Finish with four active ropes and at least one fire rope.
recommendedDirection: The chaotic build is the bonus; the proof of control is the score target.

name: Clean Ending
target: Reach the ending without using Ignite Rope.
description: Complete the community route while keeping the rope set intentionally small.
rules: Do not take Ignite Rope.
Never keep more than three active ropes.
Prioritize height and reinforcement before late Rocket Fuel.
bonusObjective: Save the completed run with a proof link or personal note.
recommendedDirection: A clean ending attempt values repeatable control over score pressure.
